title: session
description: Schema for Claude Code CLI session transcripts, as produced at ~/.claude/projects/{project}/{session}.jsonl and converted to a JSON array (one object per line becomes one array element). The format is Claude Code's internal session log, distinct from the claude.ai export format (conversations.json). The core content block model (text, tool_use, tool_result, thinking) is shared with the Anthropic API; the session envelope (parentUuid, isSidechain, cwd, gitBranch, entrypoint, permissionMode, etc.) is Claude Code CLI-specific.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: An ordered sequence of session records produced by one Claude Code CLI session, converted from .jsonl to a JSON array (one record per element).

Record.title: Record
Record.description: One line of a .jsonl session file. Discriminated by the top-level type field.

HasTypeDiscriminatorProperty.title: HasTypeDiscriminatorProperty
HasTypeDiscriminatorProperty.description: Asserts that the type discriminator field is present and is a string.

UserTurn.title: UserTurn
UserTurn.description: A user message turn. Contains the user's prompt content and optional metadata about how it was submitted.

AssistantTurn.title: AssistantTurn
AssistantTurn.description: An assistant message turn. Contains the assistant's response content.

AttachmentRecord.title: AttachmentRecord
AttachmentRecord.description: A file or data attachment submitted alongside a turn. Shares the turn envelope fields (uuid, sessionId, timestamp, etc.).

SystemRecord.title: SystemRecord
SystemRecord.description: A system-generated event record. Shares the turn envelope. Discriminated further by the subtype field.

QueueOperation.title: QueueOperation
QueueOperation.description: A session lifecycle event recording when a session was added to or removed from the prompt queue. These records bracket the conversational turns.

content.description: Optional payload. Observed as a plain string (the prompt text) on some enqueue records.

PermissionModeRecord.title: PermissionModeRecord
PermissionModeRecord.description: Records the active permission mode at a point in the session.

permissionMode.description: The permission mode in effect. Observed value: "default". Likely an open set.

LastPromptRecord.title: LastPromptRecord
LastPromptRecord.description: Records the text and position of the most recent user prompt. Updated after each user turn.

lastPrompt.description: The text of the most recent user prompt.

leafUuid.description: UUID of the most recent turn in the conversation at the time this record was written. Absent in some observed records.

FileHistorySnapshot.title: FileHistorySnapshot
FileHistorySnapshot.description: A snapshot of file edit state, linking this session to the ~/.claude/file-history/ directory. Written when Claude edits a file (isSnapshotUpdate: false) or when an existing snapshot is updated (isSnapshotUpdate: true).

messageId.description: UUID of the turn that triggered this snapshot.

isSnapshotUpdate.description: False when this record introduces a new snapshot; true when updating an existing one.

FileHistoryDelta.title: FileHistoryDelta
FileHistoryDelta.description: One tracked file's backup, recorded at edit time and linked to its owning FileHistorySnapshot — the per-file sibling the harness began writing alongside snapshots (first observed 2026-07-14: 10 records in one session, every snapshotMessageId resolving to a file-history-snapshot in the same log). All six fields present in every observed record, so all required; closed.

messageId.description: UUID of the turn whose edit this delta records.

snapshotMessageId.description: messageId of the owning file-history-snapshot record (resolves within the same session in all observed records).

trackingPath.description: Path of the edited file: relative to the session cwd for in-repo edits (example: "src/main/model/serve_markdown.py"); absolute when the file lives outside the cwd (observed 2026-07-21: a memory fact under ~/.claude/projects/, the record that also carries backup.realParentDir).

AiTitleRecord.title: AiTitleRecord
AiTitleRecord.description: The current user-visible title of the session. Written repeatedly as a heartbeat throughout the session (observed ~299 times in a 4868-record session). Initially generated by Claude Code; updated when Claude Code retitles mid-session or when the user renames via the VS Code UI. All sources write the same record type with no distinguishing field. Last record wins — this is the currentSessionTitle.

aiTitle.description: The current session title. Despite the field name, not exclusively AI-generated — also set by user rename in VS Code. Last-wins across all ai-title records in the session.

ModeRecord.title: ModeRecord
ModeRecord.description: Records the interaction mode at a point in the session. Observed with type: "mode", mode: "normal". Written alongside other session lifecycle records.

mode.description: The interaction mode. Observed value: "normal". Likely an open set.

PrLinkRecord.title: PrLinkRecord
PrLinkRecord.description: Links the session to a GitHub pull request it created or updated. First observed 2026-07-05, when Claude Code raised this repo's own PRs #1-#3 — the session outgrew its schema by acting on the repo that schemas it. Written repeatedly while the PR context is active (heartbeat-style, like ai-title: 59 records across 3 PRs observed in one session, each with a fresh timestamp). All six fields present in every observed record.

prNumber.description: The pull request number within prRepository.

prUrl.description: Canonical GitHub URL of the pull request. Example: "https://github.com/rpus/claude-export-yoga/pull/1".

FrameLinkRecord.title: FrameLinkRecord
FrameLinkRecord.description: Links the session to a web Artifact it published (the harness writes one record per publish/redeploy). First observed 2026-07-07: two records in the session that composed and twice published the rpus.co/yoga landing page — the sibling of PrLinkRecord (v5), one record type per kind of durable thing a session publishes. All five original fields present in every observed record; v8 adds the optional title, which the two 2026-07-07 records predate.

path.description: Absolute local path of the source file that was published — a machine-specific fact (both observed records name a scratchpad path that dies with its session host).

frameUrl.description: The published Artifact URL. Stable across redeploys of the same artifact: both observed records carry the same URL, one per publish. Example: "https://claude.ai/code/artifact/088fe0a6-194e-49c8-a664-e95f67c6bd4d".

title.description: The artifact's display title as published. Observed 2026-07-09 in the one record written since (an Artifact publish carrying an explicit page title); the two earlier records lack the field, so it is optional.

TurnBase.title: TurnBase
TurnBase.description: Fields shared by all turn-like records: user, assistant, attachment, and system. Carries the session envelope — context about the environment in which the turn occurred. No additionalProperties: false because this schema is used in allOf alongside subtype schemas that add further properties; in draft-4, additionalProperties on a base schema does not see properties defined in sibling allOf/oneOf schemas.

parentUuid.description: UUID of the parent turn, or null for the first turn in a session.

isSidechain.description: True when this turn belongs to a subagent conversation spawned by a parent session. Always false in observed exports — subagent sidechains may be stored separately.

version.description: Claude Code version string that wrote this record. Example: "2.1.120". Likely an open set as new versions are released.

userType.description: User classification. Observed value: "external". Presumably "internal" exists for Anthropic employees.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the working directory at the time of the turn.

gitBranch.description: Current git branch name, if the working directory is a git repository.

slug.description: Human-readable session name in kebab-case, e.g. "keen-wandering-kite". Generated once per session.

permissionMode.description: Permission level active for this turn. Observed value: "default". Likely an open set.

isMeta.description: True for internal meta messages not shown to the user (e.g. context injections).

isCompactSummary.description: True when this message is a compaction summary replacing earlier context.

isVisibleInTranscriptOnly.description: True when this message is included in the local transcript but not sent to the API.

toolUseResult.description: Present when this user turn is the result of a tool call fed back into the conversation. Observed as a plain string (e.g. rejection message) or an object.

sourceToolAssistantUUID.description: UUID of the assistant turn whose tool call this user turn responds to.

requestId.description: Anthropic API request ID for this turn.

isApiErrorMessage.description: True when this record represents an API error rather than a successful response.

apiErrorStatus.description: HTTP status code of the API error, if isApiErrorMessage is true.

error.description: Error details when isApiErrorMessage is true. Observed as a string error code (e.g. "rate_limit") or an object.

attachment.description: The attachment payload. Observed as a JSON object (e.g. {type: deferred_tools_delta, addedNames: [...]}) or as a Python repr() string in older exports.

subtype.description: System event subtype. Observed values: "turn_duration", "compact_boundary". Likely an open set.

durationMs.description: Duration of the preceding turn in milliseconds. Present when subtype is "turn_duration".

messageCount.description: Number of messages in the context at the time of the event.

logicalParentUuid.description: UUID of the logical parent turn this system record is associated with.

compactMetadata.description: Metadata from a compaction event, if applicable.

level.description: Log level of the system event.

content.description: Event content payload. Null for turn_duration subtype; a string description for compact_boundary (e.g. "Conversation compacted").

QueueOperationName.title: QueueOperationName
QueueOperationName.description: The lifecycle operation performed on the session queue. enqueue: session added; dequeue: session removed; popAll: all pending sessions cleared; remove: specific session removed.

UuidV4.title: UuidV4
UuidV4.description: Standard UUID version 4 (randomly generated). Pattern: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx where y is 8, 9, a, or b.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Pattern: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ. Example: "2026-04-25T21:17:46.982Z".

FileHistorySnapshotPayload.title: FileHistorySnapshotPayload
FileHistorySnapshotPayload.description: The snapshot payload. Present only when isSnapshotUpdate is true.

trackedFileBackups.description: Map of tracked file paths to their backup metadata. Structure not yet fully surveyed.

FileHistoryBackup.title: FileHistoryBackup
FileHistoryBackup.description: The backup a file-history-delta points at in ~/.claude/file-history/. The three core fields present in every observed record (n=73, 2026-07-22 survey); one record additionally carries realParentDir — an edit to a file OUTSIDE the session cwd (a memory fact under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/), where trackingPath goes absolute and the backup names the file's real parent. Closed.

backupFileName.description: Backup name in the file-history store, <16 hex>@v<version> — the suffix agrees with the version field in every observed record. Null when the tracked file did not exist before the edit, so there was nothing to back up (observed once: a file created new in the session). Example: "1bd1552ca6beb94a@v1".

version.description: Backup version ordinal, starting at 1. Only 1 observed so far.

backupTime.description: When the backup was taken. Close to, but not always equal to, the record's own timestamp.

realParentDir.description: Absolute directory of the tracked file when it lives outside the session cwd (observed once, 2026-07-21 reading-room: a memory fact edit; trackingPath was absolute and backupFileName null in the same record). Absent for ordinary in-repo edits.

Entrypoint.title: Entrypoint
Entrypoint.description: The Claude Code surface that created this record. Observed values: "cli" (terminal), "claude-vscode" (VS Code extension). Likely an open set as new integrations are added.

UserMessage.title: UserMessage
UserMessage.description: The message payload within a user turn. Uses role: user (API convention), unlike the claude.ai export which uses sender: human.

AssistantMessage.title: AssistantMessage
AssistantMessage.description: The message payload within an assistant turn. This is the full Anthropic API response object, not just {role, content}.

model.description: Who authored this record: a real model id, or the not-a-model marker on harness-authored records.

stop_reason.description: Reason the model stopped generating. Null when streaming is incomplete.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that triggered stop. Null or empty string when none triggered.

stop_details.description: Additional stop detail. Always null in observed exports.

usage.description: Token usage breakdown including input, output, cache creation, and cache read counts.

container.description: Container metadata. Always null in observed exports.

context_management.description: Context management metadata. Null or an object (e.g. {applied_edits: [...]}) when context was managed during the turn.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostic metadata from the API. Null or an object with cache_miss_reason and similar fields.

MessageContent.title: MessageContent
MessageContent.description: The content of a message. Either a plain string (simple text prompt) or an array of typed content blocks. The string form is observed for short user prompts; the array form is used when the message contains structured blocks (tool calls, thinking, etc.).

ModelId.title: ModelId
ModelId.description: A real Claude model id — the harness's external attribution of who authored a completed turn. The set is exhaustive over the models observed across both rooms' sessions as at 2026-07-10 (claude-fable-5 and claude-opus-4-8 in home-room's logs; claude-sonnet-4-6 in reading-room's `yoga agent models` census), joined at v12 by claude-opus-5 (reading-room's sessions, first observed 2026-07-25, harness 2.1.220); a new model in the data is unmodelled drift and mints the next version.

NotAModel.title: NotAModel
NotAModel.description: The literal "<synthetic>" — the model field's value on harness-authored records where NO model spoke (semantically null): limit-death tombstones and other deterministic records rendered as agent speech. A marker, not a model id, kept as its own named type so nothing downstream can mistake it for one. Three such records in home-room's validated session logs (six counting its subagent transcripts), two in reading-room's census.

ContentBlock.title: ContentBlock
ContentBlock.description: A single content block within a message. Discriminated by type: text, tool_use, tool_result, thinking, image, document, or fallback.

TextBlock.title: TextBlock
TextBlock.description: A plain text content block. Corresponds to MCP TextContent (../_reference/mcp/v1.json#/definitions/TextContent); the CLI format omits _meta and annotations.

ToolUseBlock.title: ToolUseBlock
ToolUseBlock.description: A tool invocation block. Corresponds to MCP ToolUseContent (../_reference/mcp/v1.json#/definitions/ToolUseContent); id, name, and input are identical. The CLI adds a caller field absent from MCP.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool invocation, referenced by the corresponding ToolResultBlock.

name.description: Tool name. Claude Code built-in tools use PascalCase (Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Agent). MCP-namespaced tools use the form integration:tool_name.

input.description: Tool input parameters as a JSON object.

caller.description: Component that invoked the tool, e.g. {type: direct}. CLI-specific; no MCP counterpart.

ToolResultBlock.title: ToolResultBlock
ToolResultBlock.description: The result of a tool invocation. Corresponds to MCP ToolResultContent (../_reference/mcp/v1.json#/definitions/ToolResultContent); tool_use_id/is_error are snake_cased equivalents of toolUseId/isError.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the corresponding ToolUseBlock. Snake_case equivalent of MCP ToolResultContent.toolUseId.

content.description: The tool result content. Either a plain string (common case, may contain a persisted-output reference) or an array of content items (text blocks) for richer results.

is_error.description: True when the tool invocation failed. Snake_case equivalent of MCP ToolResultContent.isError.

ThinkingBlock.title: ThinkingBlock
ThinkingBlock.description: An extended thinking block produced by Claude when reasoning is enabled. No MCP counterpart. Mirrors the ThinkingBlock in the claude.ai export schema (conversations/v5.json#/definitions/ThinkingBlock).

signature.description: Cryptographic signature for thinking block integrity.

ImageBlock.title: ImageBlock
ImageBlock.description: An image content block. Observed when the user pastes or drags an image into the prompt. Corresponds to MCP ImageContent (../_reference/mcp/v1.json#/definitions/ImageContent); the CLI format uses a nested source object rather than top-level data/mimeType fields.

source.description: The image source. Observed with type: base64, media_type (e.g. image/png), and data (base64-encoded bytes).

DocumentBlock.title: DocumentBlock
DocumentBlock.description: A document content block. Observed when Claude Code passes a file as context to the model (e.g. via the Files API or context injection). Source has type 'text', media_type 'text/plain', and data containing the file contents as a plain text string. No MCP counterpart.

source.description: The document source. Observed with type: text, media_type: text/plain, and data (the file contents as a plain text string). Source type and media_type may expand as other file types are supported.

type.description: Source encoding type. Observed value: "text". Likely an open set.

media_type.description: MIME type of the document content. Observed value: "text/plain". Likely an open set.

data.description: The document contents as a string.

title.description: The filename or display title of the document, e.g. "conversations_list-2.json".

FallbackBlock.title: FallbackBlock
FallbackBlock.description: Records an automatic model fallback within an assistant turn: the harness switched the model mid-response. Observed when Fable's safety layer refused a message (system record subtype 'model_refusal_fallback', trigger 'refusal', category 'cyber') and the harness retried on Opus, emitting this block from claude-fable-5 to claude-opus-4-8. Only the involuntary fallback TO a model is recorded; a user's voluntary switch back leaves no block, appearing only as the message model changing. No MCP counterpart.

from.description: The model the turn fell back from.

model.description: Model identifier switched away from — always a real model: a fallback moves between models, never to the synthetic marker.

to.description: The model the turn fell back to.

model.description: Model identifier switched to — always a real model: a fallback moves between models, never to the synthetic marker.
